pattern: INTERNS! I WILL PAY YOU IN COMPLIMENTS!
SECURITY! ANYONE! I WILL GIVE YOU A PLAQUE!
WHERE ARE MY INTERNS? I SHOULD HAVE PAID THEM. NO. NEVER.
BEHOLD MY GOLD-PLATED MOPED. YES, IT IS STILL CHARGING.
I HAVE MORE MONEY THAN TASTE, AND I HAVE NO TASTE.
MY THIRD WIFE IS WATCHING. WAVE, DARLING. SHE IS ASLEEP.
I OWN THIS STREET. I OWN THAT STREET. I RENT YOUR STREET TO YOU.
NAIL GUN! A NAIL GUN FOR THE MAN WHO HAS EVERYTHING!
I HAVE A YACHT BIGGER THAN YOUR WHOLE FAMILY TREE.
PAY ATTENTION. ATTENTION IS THE ONLY THING I DO NOT CHARGE FOR.
THE POOR ARE SO SWEATY. LOOK AT THEM SWEAT.
MY MOPED HAS HEATED SEATS. MY BUTT IS A KING.
I PUT MY LAWYER ON SPEED DIAL. HE IS ALSO ON THIS MOPED.
I HAVE NOT CARRIED MY OWN WALLET SINCE NINETEEN SIXTY.
CHARGE! I SAID CHARGE! THE MOPED NEEDS A CHARGE!
hurt: MY SUSPENSION!
MY HIP! MY GOLD HIP!
THAT WAS MY GOOD KIDNEY. I BOUGHT IT.
UNHAND MY MOPED, YOU PEASANT!
DO YOU KNOW HOW MUCH THIS CRAVAT COST?
MY TOUPEE HAS SHIFTED. NOBODY LOOK.
MY FACELIFT IS COMING DOWN!
I WILL SUE YOU. I WILL SUE YOUR FISTS SEPARATELY.
THE BATTERY! WATCH THE BATTERY!
THAT DENT WILL COST YOU A YEAR OF WAGES. WHICH I SET.
MY PACEMAKER IS GOLD-PLATED TOO. IT IS SKIPPING.
OW. THIS IS WHY I HAVE BODYGUARDS. WHERE ARE MY BODYGUARDS?
I FIRED MY BODYGUARDS TO SAVE MONEY. BAD CALL.
MY LITTLE BLUE PILL FELL OUT OF MY POCKET! NOBODY PICK THAT UP!
MY BUTLER WILL HEAR ABOUT THIS. HE WILL SIGH.
MY GOLD TEETH! THE GOLD TEETH ARE LOOSE!
AH! MY PORTFOLIO! I MEAN MY PELVIS!
THAT IS ASSAULT ON A BILLIONAIRE. THAT IS ALMOST TREASON.
MY MOPED SQUEAKS LIKE MY KNEES NOW.
STOP IT! I HAVE A BAD HEART AND A WORSE PERSONALITY!
MY HAIR PLUGS! THEY ARE LOOSE!
MY CUFFLINKS ARE WORTH MORE THAN YOUR HOUSE! DO NOT DENT THEM!
OW! I HAVE NOT FELT PAIN SINCE NINETEEN FIFTY!
WHERE IS MY BUTLER? WHERE IS MY OTHER BUTLER?
YOU HIT A MAN WITH A BAD HIP AND A WORSE ATTITUDE!
MY SPRAY TAN IS RUNNING!
THE GOLD PLATING IS CHIPPING! THERE IS ONLY PLASTIC UNDER IT!
I WILL BUY YOUR LANDLORD AND RAISE YOUR RENT!
MY DENTURES ARE ON THE FLOOR. GOLD DENTURES. PICK THEM UP.
OOF. I AM GOING TO NEED A NEW HIP. A GOLD ONE.
defeat: CALL MY LAWYER. CALL TRIPLE A.
MY BATTERY IS AT ZERO. MY DIGNITY IS AT ZERO.
I BOUGHT EVERYTHING EXCEPT A SPARE BATTERY.
TOW ME HOME, CHAUFFEUR. WAIT. I SOLD THE CHAUFFEUR.
THE CITY WILL RISE AGAIN. AT MARKET RATE.
TELL MY THIRD WIFE THE PRENUP STILL STANDS.
I WILL BUY THIS GAME AND DELETE YOU FROM IT.
MY MOPED. MY BEAUTIFUL GOLD MOPED. IT IS JUST A MOPED.
FOUR MILES AN HOUR WAS NOT ENOUGH.
PUT IT ON MY TAB. I HAVE A VERY LONG TAB.
I NEED A NAP AND A TAX BREAK.
I AM TOO RICH TO LOSE. THIS IS A CLERICAL ERROR.
card: I BOUGHT THIS CITY. I CAN BUY YOUR CONTINUE TOO.
I PAY MY INTERNS IN EXPOSURE. I WILL PAY YOU IN PAIN.
MY MOPED IS GOLD. MY NAIL GUN IS GOLD. MY HEART IS COAL.
TOP SPEED, FOUR MILES AN HOUR. BOTTOM SPEED, YOUR WHOLE FAMILY.
I HAVE NEVER LOST. I HAVE PAID OTHER PEOPLE TO LOSE.
WELCOME TO MY PENTHOUSE. WIPE YOUR FEET. ON THE PEASANT.
I OWN THE ELEVATOR. I OWN THE ROOF. I OWN THE AIR UP HERE.
MY PRENUP IS LONGER THAN THIS FIGHT WILL BE.
I WILL NAIL YOU TO THE WALL. LEGALLY. I OWN THE WALL.
MONEY CANNOT BUY HAPPINESS. IT CAN BUY A NAIL GUN.
I AM CHARGING. THE MOPED IS ALSO CHARGING. PLEASE WAIT.
YOUR FAMILY IS POOR. I CAN SMELL IT FROM UP HERE.
